mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in UNRATE above 6.6% indicates improving labor market conditions, which typically boost investor confidence and drive positive 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when UNRATE crosses above 6.6%.

mechanism_narrative: Strong demand growth (GDPC1) and robust housing activity (HOUST) simultaneously signal a healthy economy, prompting market optimism and positive 60-day S&P 500 returns.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 rises >2% and HOUST > 1000 units in the same month
failure_condition: The combination of GDPC1 > 2% rise and HOUST > 1000 units does not occur in 60% of triggered instances, or returns are not positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, high supply growth (INDPRO) and falling inflation (CPIAUCSL) create favorable conditions for equity valuations, driving positive 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: The late-cycle expansion regime (INDPRO >105 and CPIAUCSL <235) does not hold in 60% of instances, or returns are not positive (t-test p >0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Low federal funds rates (FEDFUNDS) paired with strong demand (GDPC1) create an expansionary monetary environment that lowers discount rates, enhancing equity valuations and generating positive 5-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: The FEDFUNDS <0.05% and GDPC1 >18000 combination occurs less than 30% of the time, or returns are not positive (t-test p >0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in INDPRO above 105 points to robust supply-side dynamics, which typically correlate with market optimism and positive 5-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are not significantly positive (t-test p >0.05) when INDPRO rises >2%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in PAYEMS (unemployment) below recent trends signals labor market strength, fostering investor confidence and positive 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: PAYEMS does not trend downward by 1% over 6 months, or 20-day returns are not significantly positive (t-test p >0.05).

mechanism_narrative: During a late-cycle demand surge, high GDP growth (GDPC1) and strong housing starts (HOUST) drive market optimism, leading to positive 60-day S&P 500 returns.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 > 18000 and HOUST > 1000 units in the same month
failure_condition: The late-cycle demand surge regime (GDPC1 >18000 and HOUST >1000) occurs in <50% of instances, or returns are not positive (t-test p >0.05).
